props.gloss_en: the mishna: one who writes two letters, whether with his right hand or with his left ... is liable
R' Yosei: they obligated [for] two letters only on account of marking, for so they would write on the boards of the Tabernacle to know which was its pair
the stam: for the right hand, granted -- that is the way of writing; but for the left hand, that is not the way of writing
R' Yirmeya: they taught it of a left-handed man
Abaye: [they taught it] of one who has command of both his hands
Rav Yaakov son of Bat Yaakov: whose is this [mishna]? it is R' Yosei's
the stam: the whole of it [reisha and seifa] is R' Yosei's

supports.gloss_en: דאמר לא חייבו שתי אותיות אלא משום רושם -- R' Yosei's marking-rationale is the reason Rav Yaakov gives for assigning the mishna to him

objections.gloss_en: בשלמא איימין ליחייב ... אלא אשמאל אמאי? הא אין דרך כתיבה בכך -- why is one liable with the left hand? that is not the way of writing! (R' Yirmeya's answer is refuted, so is not listed)

answered_by.gloss_en: אלא אמר אביי: בשולט בשתי ידיו -- of one who has command of both hands (= p_okimta_shulet)

הא מני -- רבי יוסי היא, דאמר לא חייבו שתי אותיות אלא משום רושם -- it is R' Yosei's, for whom the liability is for marking (= p_ha_mani_r_yosei; the link to the left-hand question is implicit -- header)

objections.gloss_en: ותהוי שמאל דידיה כימין דכולי עלמא, ואשמאל ליחייב, איימין לא ליחייב -- then let his left be like everyone's right: liable for the left, not liable for the right! (unanswered; the text turns to Abaye)
והא מדסיפא רבי יוסי היא, רישא לאו רבי יוסי -- since the seifa is [named as] R' Yosei, the reisha is not R' Yosei!

answered_by.gloss_en: כולה רבי יוסי היא -- the whole of it is R' Yosei (= p_kula_r_yosei)
